content.title: Plant-A-Tree Program
content.summary: The City of Arvada's Plant-A-Tree Program allows community members to partner with the City Forestry Team to plant trees in local parks as a way to commemorate loved ones or celebrate special occasions. Running from mid-May to mid-September, the program charges a flat rate of $400 per tree and offers planting times Monday through Thursday. Interested individuals can apply online through Civic Rec, where they can select the type of tree and location, subject to availability.

![People posing for a photo with shovels after planting a tree](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=5397 "People posing for a photo with shovels after planting a tree")

## About the Plant-A-Tree Program

Through the City of Arvada's Plant-A-Tree Program, community members partner with our City Forestry Team to plant trees in Arvada parks. The program provides the opportunity for a rewarding and unique means of commemorating loved ones, paying tribute, honoring or celebrating special times.

This visible and vibrant reminder also provides shade and beauty for future generations to enjoy. For more than 50 years, Arvada's Plant-A-Tree Program has contributed more than 400 trees to our park system!

To purchase a tree, fill out a Plant-A-Tree Program application on the City's online recreation management system, [Civic Rec](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=c2VhcmNoPSZjYXRlZ29yeSU1QjM2NTg0JTVEPTEmcmVudGFsJTVCZnJvbSU1RD0mcmVudGFsJTVCdG8lNUQ9JjQ1NzBkMmJkZGM1OTdkODQzMmFiYTc2NWYyM2YzNDM5PTY2MjRiZmRkNzgyOTM5M2ZmMjk1MGRkOTE5YTg2NWIy).

[Submit Application](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=c2VhcmNoPSZjYXRlZ29yeSU1QjM2NTg0JTVEPTEmcmVudGFsJTVCZnJvbSU1RD0mcmVudGFsJTVCdG8lNUQ9JjQ1NzBkMmJkZGM1OTdkODQzMmFiYTc2NWYyM2YzNDM5PTY2MjRiZmRkNzgyOTM5M2ZmMjk1MGRkOTE5YTg2NWIy)

### Program details

- The Plant-A-Tree program runs from mid-May through mid-September.
- Planting times are available Monday through Thursday from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m.
- $400 flat rate per tree
- Get started by [submitting an application on Civic Rec](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=c2VhcmNoPSZjYXRlZ29yeSU1QjM2NTg0JTVEPTEmcmVudGFsJTVCZnJvbSU1RD0mcmVudGFsJTVCdG8lNUQ9JjQ1NzBkMmJkZGM1OTdkODQzMmFiYTc2NWYyM2YzNDM5PTY2MjRiZmRkNzgyOTM5M2ZmMjk1MGRkOTE5YTg2NWIy)
- Through the application, you will select your preferred type of tree, location (if available) and let us know the occasion you would like the tree to commemorate
- Please keep in mind that not all Arvada parks have the capacity to plant new trees, which includes but is not limited to the Majestic View Nature Center and Park, Memorial Park and McIlvoy Park in Olde Town
- After the application is submitted, the City Forester will contact you to finalize details such as the exact planting location, date and time
- Once details for the tree planting have been finalized, you will be sent an email from Civic Rec with a link to pay online

## Contact

For questions about the Plant-A-Tree program, email [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#d5a5b9b4bba1f8b4f8a1a7b0b095b4a7a3b4b1b4fbbaa7b2), request information/service regarding City trees through [Ask Arvada](https://seeclickfix.com/web_portal/m96AzqbgQ9RW9z5CcqFqEwP8/issues/map), or contact Parks Maintenance at 720-898-7410.
